separate.name: separate networks of the final notebook

models.switch: developer setting: both use the same pipeline; only the ONNX file and the heads entry (input_selection, features, classes) of the chosen config file change

model.onnx_inputs: x: float32 (reps, C_sel, T_LEN) raw stored channels in mt_final.json heads[ex].input_selection order; f: float32 (reps, F) raw per-rep features in heads[ex].features order, NaN allowed. Output 'probs': (reps, K) in heads[ex].classes order. Normalisation is inside the file.

mediapipe.api: MediaPipe Tasks PoseLandmarker (NOT ML Kit, NOT MoveNet: the network was trained on this model)
mediapipe.running_mode: VIDEO (recorded) or LIVE_STREAM (camera); timestamps in ms must increase
mediapipe.landmarks: normalized landmarks (x, y in 0..1 of the frame, z, visibility, presence) AND world landmarks (metres); keep the frame width/height: pixel = normalized x width / y height
mediapipe.camera: feed the camera image NOT mirrored (selfie previews are mirrored: un-mirror before MediaPipe), upright (rotate by the sensor orientation), the whole body from the knees up in view, from the front

pipeline.side: e2/e3: the arm that does the exercise; e1 (both arms, stick): the injured arm - the app asks it
pipeline.get_ready: ask the patient to stand still about 2 s before the first rep (the first-break reference)

e1.elb: Keep your elbows straight while you lift the stick
e1.rngdown: Lower the stick all the way down between reps
e1.imb: Lift the stick evenly - raise your {arm} arm as high as the other one

e2.rngdown: Bring your arm all the way down to your side between reps
e2.shld: Do not shrug - keep your shoulder down while the arm goes up to shoulder height
e2.lean: Keep your trunk upright - do not lean to lift the arm

e3.wrong: Keep your elbow against your body while you rotate

messages.range_top: Lift a bit higher: target {target:.0f} deg, you reached {reached:.0f} deg
messages.unsure: Not sure about this rep - check that your whole body is in view
messages.partial: Rep cut by the start/end of the recording - not scored

feedback.rule: confidence < min_confidence -> 'unsure' message; partial reps (cut by start/end) are counted, not scored

silhouette.function: pose_worker.sil_features(mask, lm): mask = MediaPipe segmentation mask (float 0..1, > 0.5 = person) at the size of the analysed frame, lm = normalized landmarks (33x5); returns (2, 9): row 0 = person's LEFT arm, row 1 = RIGHT arm
